description: Work with nanobot from Linear issues through native Agent Sessions.
requirements: A private Linear OAuth app and a stable public HTTPS callback URL

setup.tryIt: Mention the app in an issue comment or delegate an issue to it. Follow-ups inside its Agent Session do not need another mention.
setup.summary: Create a private Linear OAuth app, save its credentials and public URL, then authorize each workspace. Start a session by mentioning the app or delegating an issue to it; ordinary comments are ignored.
steps: Expose this nanobot instance through a stable HTTPS URL (a tunnel is fine).
Create a private OAuth app in Linear with read, write, app:mentionable, and app:assignable scopes.
Subscribe the app webhook to AgentSessionEvent, PermissionChange, and OAuthAuthorization using the generated webhook URL.
Connect the workspace with OAuth, then mention the app or delegate an issue to it.

clientId.label: OAuth client ID
clientId.help: Copy it from the private OAuth app in Linear.

clientSecret.label: OAuth client secret
clientSecret.help: Stored only by this nanobot instance.

webhookSigningSecret.label: Webhook signing secret
webhookSigningSecret.help: Used to verify Linear-Signature before any webhook body is parsed.

publicBaseUrl.label: Public HTTPS URL
publicBaseUrl.help: A stable HTTPS origin routed to the listener below; do not include a path.

allowFrom.label: Allowed Linear users
allowFrom.help: Leave empty to use nanobot pairing, or use * to allow every user in connected workspaces.

showReasoning.label: Show reasoning
showReasoning.help: Post model reasoning as thought activities in Linear. Turn this off for a quieter session.

custom.secretSaveFailed: Could not confirm the save. Try again or cancel.
custom.authorizeDescription: Continue in Linear to choose a workspace and authorize nanobot. Return here when you're done.
custom.savePublicUrl: Enter a public HTTPS URL to create a Linear app.
custom.accessAll: Every member of an authorized workspace can run this agent.
custom.accessRestricted: Only the Linear user IDs listed in Advanced can run this agent.
custom.accessPairing: Pair on first use; connect Linear MCP to search or edit issues.
custom.noWorkspaces: No workspaces are authorized. Connect a workspace to receive Linear agent requests.
custom.disconnectDescription: Revoke this workspace's authorization and clear its member access settings in nanobot. Linear issues, comments, and nanobot conversation history will be kept. Other workspaces are not affected. You can authorize this workspace again later.
custom.disconnectLast: This is the last connected workspace, so the Linear channel will also be turned off.
custom.addWorkspaceHelp: Uses the current Linear app. To connect another workspace, the app must allow installation in other workspaces; private apps only work in their own workspace. Authorizing an existing workspace updates its connection without creating a duplicate.
custom.resetDescription: Disconnect all workspaces linked through this app and stop the channel.
custom.resetClearsDetail: Member access settings and this instance’s app configuration, including saved credentials.
custom.resetKeepsDetail: Linear app, issues, comments, chat history and pairing approvals.
custom.resetIncomplete: Reset is incomplete. Workspaces already removed stay removed; retry to finish the remaining steps.
custom.resetInspectFailed: Could not verify connected workspaces. App settings were kept.
custom.resetChanged: Another workspace was connected. Review the connections and try again.
custom.resetStopFailed: The Linear channel could not be stopped. App settings were kept.
custom.resetSaveFailed: Could not clear the app settings. Please retry.

members.title: Member access
members.help: Enable members to use nanobot without a pairing code. Linear's existing authorization still applies. This does not grant access to the nanobot admin UI. Turning access off blocks new requests, not tasks already running.
members.allowAll: Advanced settings currently allow all members (*), including new members. Individual off switches still take precedence. Remove * to require approval for new members.
members.retry: Refresh members to check the current state and try again.
members.saveUnconfirmed: Access was not confirmed. Refresh members before trying again.
members.guide: Use Member access to approve teammates without pairing codes. Existing approvals still work unless switched off. Connect Linear MCP to search or edit issues.
members.intro: Choose who can use nanobot in Linear. No pairing codes needed.
